mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT a.id FROM activities a INNER JOIN activity_participants ap ON a.id = ap.activity_id WHERE ap.student_no = #{studentNo} UNION ALL SELECT pa.id FROM pending_activities pa WHERE pa.submitted_by = #{studentNo} UNION ALL SELECT pbi.id FROM pending_batch_imports pbi WHERE pbi.submitted_by = #{studentNo} AND pbi.status IN ('PENDING', 'REJECTED') ) t
